Name: (CP) Every Meal Matters
Author: GalaxyRobotMods
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/m0Lfzhm.png[/img]
I always thought that only some foods were important. Personally, I got tired of buying salads for Gus because it's his best food. I got tired of eating miners' treats and getting diabetes. I have a phobia of fish because I've eaten so much trout soup to improve my fishing level, etc.

With this mod, try to give each food item a purpose! Even if it's small, you might find it useful for more than just restoring energy and health!.

[size=1]Note: This is not a new version of the mod [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5282]More Food Buff[/url]﻿[size=1], this is my own version built from scratch[/size]
